theorems.name: Submission.ted_tangent_plane_facts
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U, (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)) ∧ ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (R : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f (closedBall 0 R) → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∀ x' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, x = q (graphPoint x' (f x')) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x' → V.tangentProj x = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ f x' v)))).starProjection
